trial_court: Additional District Judge, 10th Court at Alipore, South 24-Parganas (Matrimonial Suit No.10 of 2016 and Misc. Case No.7 of 2016)
case_name: Lavina Bhagnani alias Muskaan Karan Chainani v. Karan Manoj Chainani
facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife filed a matrimonial suit and an application for maintenance pendente lite under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, pending before the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: A revisional application should be disposed of expeditiously.
legal_principles.held: Taking into account the stage of the suit as also the age of the suit, this revisional application is disposed of with a direction upon the learned Court below to dispose of the miscellaneous case as also the matrimonial suit expeditiously.

legal_principles.principle: The court should not go into the merits of a case in a revisional application.
legal_principles.held: This Court has not gone into the merits of the case and the learned Court below shall proceed with the case and dispose of the same independently.

outcome.final_order: The trial court is directed to dispose of the miscellaneous case within two months and the matrimonial suit within six months thereafter.

keywords: Latin maxim: justice delayed is justice denied
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for expeditious disposal of a matrimonial suit
